estimatedFields: runway.lengthM (Wikipedia, Rogers Dry Lake 15/33, 10.0 km), runway.widthM (not found; the STS-1 profile's 90 m) and runway.headingDeg (from the runway number)
touchdown.keas (the report gives 156.6 knots without saying whether equivalent or ground speed)
touchdown.noseAfterMainFt (the report gives the nose gear 6 s after the mains, not the distance: about 6 s at 250 ft/s)
rollout.stopFt (the report gives the wheels-stop time, 56 s after the mains, not the distance: constant deceleration from 156.6 kt over 56 s, 7,400 ft, from the main-gear point at -537 ft)
rollout.brakeAfterMainFt (brake speed not reported; 118 kt assumed from STS-31's 119 and STS-93's 117.2, at 6 ft/s2, 3,307 ft before the stop)
taem.mach, taem.altFt, taem.rangeNmi (the 2006 guidance workbook's nominal values; taem.met is the report's major mode change 305, which it labels terminal area energy management)
approach (the workbook's 20 deg and 1.5 deg glideslopes and preflare at 2,000 ft; gear down at 250 ft from the STS-1 press-kit plan; the flown values were not found)
entry.reversalsMach (no per-flight list of the roll-reversal Mach numbers was sourced; left empty)

provenance.l: STS-37 Space Shuttle Mission Report (NASA, 1991): deorbit burn 101:12:45:50.1 GMT, 221.4 s, 438.6 ft/s; entry interface 101:13:24:23; major mode change 305 at 101:13:48:47; main gear 101:13:55:29 on lakebed runway 33 at 156.6 kt, 537 ft short of the threshold, 4 ft/s sink after an 80 kt wind shear; nose gear 6 s later; wheels stop 101:13:56:25; no blackout (TDRS).
